To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the mass of the light rho meson is not sensitive to the non-Abelian gluon self-interactions in the quark-gluons vertex, that the mass of a heavy rho-meson-like state is significantly affected by the non-Abelan gluon self-interacions, and that the non-Abela gluon self-intercations lead to a reduction of the pion mass.
the gluon self-coupling is not important for the pion, that it is important for the rho meson, and that it can be important for the eta and eta' mesons.
the gluon self interaction is important for the description of light mesons and the corresponding effects are not fully compensated by pion cloud effects.

the nonperturbative dynamics of QCD and the properties of hadrons.
the nonperturbative aspects of the QCD Lagrangian.
the development and application of a novel approach to QCD.

the nonperturbative gluon self-interactions do not play a significant role for the masses of light mesons.
